meta.note: Dark values come from the Tecton Storybook captures (tecton-screenshots/114_foundations-colors__overview.png etc.). `--tecton-*` names are reconstructed from the truncated CSS-variable column and will be aligned with the generated CSS export when it is pasted.

card-foreground.note: Tecton has no card-specific text token; text-primary is used on every surface.

popover.note: Elevated surface for menus and popovers (same value as bg-paper).

primary-foreground.note: Text on the primary action surface (hover/press text is #ffffff in Tecton; Vega uses primary/80 on hover instead).

secondary-foreground.note: Text on the secondary action surface.

muted.note: Tecton has no generic 'muted surface'; the filled-input background (#28232c, also the table footer) is the closest subdued surface.

accent.note: shadcn uses accent for hover/selected rows and ghost hover; Tecton's tertiary hover surface (#3a343e, same as secondary bg and table hover) plays that role.

destructive.note: Error status main; shadcn draws destructive text on background and destructive buttons with white text.

input.note: Outlined input border (same value as divider-medium).

ring.note: Keyboard focus outline. Vega renders it as ring-3 ring-ring/50; Tecton draws a solid 2px ring.

chart-1.note: Chart series colours are chosen from the 7 Tecton accents in the order used by the Cost-vs-Risk panel.

sidebar.note: Sidebar sits on the paper surface, like Tecton's side panels.

radius.note: Default Tecton corner radius (4px). Non-colour: the light value is the same reference.

success.note: New token (documented shadcn pattern) for the filled success surface; used by custom components only.

success-foreground.note: Text on the filled success surface.

warning-foreground.note: Text on the filled warning surface.

info-foreground.note: Text on the filled info surface.

neutral-foreground.note: Text on the filled neutral surface.

destructive-foreground.note: Text on the filled error surface. shadcn v4 dropped this token; Tecton restores it for filled error chips/alerts.

light.note: Tecton ships no light theme; every light value is approximated. Strategy: `overrides` mirror the dark palette using Tecton's own tokens (page background = text-primary, foreground = bg-default, secondary/accent surfaces = action-primary-text, borders = outlined hover border, status surfaces = the status *muted* tokens with near-white text, chart accents unchanged). Any variable without an override falls back to OKLCH lightness inversion (L' = 1 - L, hue/chroma/alpha kept, clamped to sRGB).

overrideNotes.background: text-primary (#f6f5f8) mirrored as the page surface; card/popover/sidebar are pure white to keep the paper-vs-page relationship.
overrideNotes.foreground: bg-default (#1d1c1f) mirrored as the text colour.
overrideNotes.primary: Pure inversion of #5d4d68 gives L 0.553, on which neither black nor white text reaches 4.5:1. A deeper shade of the same hue with light text (6.40:1) keeps the light-on-purple relationship. Applies to sidebar-primary too.
overrideNotes.secondary: action-primary-text (#e5e0eb) reused as the light secondary/accent surface; secondary-foreground is action-secondary-bg (#3a343e).
overrideNotes.muted: Light grey close to the mirrored filled-input surface; muted-foreground darkened from text-placeholder (#6a696c) to reach 4.5:1 on white.
overrideNotes.destructive: Between status-error-main (#c16e6c, 3.4:1 on white) and status-error-muted (#832d28); chosen to reach 4.5:1 as text on the page background.
overrideNotes.ring: The brand focus pink (#ff52a8) only reaches 2.75:1 on the light page surface, so light mode uses a deeper shade of the same hue (#e0248c, ≥ 3:1 on white and on the page background).
overrideNotes.chart-1: Chart accents are mid-tone and stay identical in light mode (charts 1-5).
overrideNotes.success: status-success-muted (#217846) with near-white text; warning/info use status-warning-muted (#995b04) / status-info-muted (#3766c4) the same way.
overrideNotes.neutral: status-neutral-bright (#c8c7ca) with status-neutral-filled-bg (#2c2b2e) as text — the dark pair mirrored.
